subject: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter needed for renewal procurement
body:
Message 1
From: Samir Patel <procurement@brightwell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: latest SOC 2 Type II + bridge for renewal

Hi Marissa,

We are kicking off our renewal for Redwood (contract BW-3421) and need to validate audit coverage for FY26. Our procurement and legal teams require the latest SOC 2 Type II report covering the period ended 2026-12-31, and — because our PO cutover is scheduled before your next Type II is released — a formal bridge letter that confirms interim coverage for the renewal window.

Could you share:
- The most recent SOC 2 Type II PDF (or link to a secure portal)
- A bridge letter or interim attestation that covers Jan 1, 2027 through the renewal date (we're targeting 2027-05-10 for PO issuance)
- Any additional evidence or checklist BrightWell should include in our procurement package (procurement@brightwell.com will upload to our SRM)

Also please confirm who on your side will be the point contact for our legal team if they have follow-up questions on controls scope.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Sr. Procurement Manager
BrightWell Health
procurement@brightwell.com

---

Message 2
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <procurement@brightwell.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest SOC 2 Type II + bridge for renewal

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and the timeline. Happy to help.

Quick answers:
- I attached our latest SOC 2 Type II (period ended 2026-12-31) to this thread for procurement.
- We can produce a bridge letter that covers the interim period up to 2027-05-10. I will loop in Dev (security/compliance lead) to prepare the attestation language; he will propose wording used in prior bridge letters.
- Procurement checklist: I attached a simple template (BrightWell_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx) that lists the items most common in enterprise renewals (reports, bridge, Sig/CAIQ snapshot, incident history summary). If legal wants the SIG/CAIQ, we can provide a completed CAIQ export as well.

One clarification: does your legal team need the bridge to reference specific control categories (e.g., CC6 continuity) or will a general interim attestation suffice? If you can confirm, we will tailor the language.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment(s): Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf, BrightWell_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx

---

Message 3
From: Lisa Nguyen <legal@brightwell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <procurement@brightwell.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest SOC 2 Type II + bridge for renewal

Thanks Marissa — I received the PDF and the checklist. A couple of asks from Legal:
1) The bridge letter should call out that there have been no material changes in control environment since 2026-12-31, and should expressly reference that incident response and access controls remain consistent with the previous report.
2) We also need a copy of your most recent SIG questionnaire or a populated CAIQ export; we use that for our internal risk scoring.

If you can provide a bridge letter with those two points and the CAIQ, we can proceed with PO approval. We aim to submit the PO by 2027-05-10.

Best,
Lisa Nguyen
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
BrightWell Health
legal@brightwell.com

---

Message 4
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Nguyen <legal@brightwell.com>, Samir Patel <procurement@brightwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest SOC 2 Type II + bridge for renewal

Hi Lisa / Samir — looping in Vivek (Head of Security) for final sign-off on language. Per Marissa's attachments, please see the attached bridge letter draft and the CAIQ export. The bridge confirms:
- No material changes to the control environment since 2026-12-31
- Incident response processes and access controls remain in effect as described in the 2026 report
- This bridge covers the period 2027-01-01 through 2027-05-10 to align with BrightWell's renewal window

Attachments: Bridge_Letter_20270504.pdf, Redwood_CA IQ_export_202704.pdf

Next steps:
- If the wording looks good, we can finalize the bridge and provide a signed PDF via DocuSign. I have prepared an envelope and can send it to legal@brightwell.com once you confirm.
- CAIQ is included for your risk team. If you need a SIG Lite spreadsheet or more granular evidence items (e.g., control narratives or tech asset inventory), tell us which items are highest priority and we'll add them to an Evidence Pack.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
Attachment(s): Bridge_Letter_20270504.pdf, Redwood_CAIQ_export_202704.json

---

Message 5
From: Samir Patel <procurement@brightwell.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Nguyen <legal@brightwell.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest SOC 2 Type II + bridge for renewal

Dev / Marissa — this looks good and addresses our legal requirements. Two quick items:
1) Please send the signed bridge via DocuSign and copy procurement@brightwell.com. The HubSpot record for this deal is linked here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/BW-3421
2) We accepted the CAIQ; our risk team may follow up with a short list of clarifying questions but that is not blocking.

If you can get the signed bridge before 2027-05-06, we should be able to route the PO for approval and meet our 2027-05-10 issuance target.

Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Samir
Sr. Procurement Manager
BrightWell Health
procurement@brightwell.com

--
Thread notes: Bridge letter and SOC2 attached; CAIQ export included. Final item: DocuSign envelope pending (https://docusign.example.com/envelope/123456789).
